import numpy as np, collections, json, os, re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def quads(M):
    h,w=M.shape; return {'TL':M[:h//2,:w//2],'TR':M[:h//2,w//2:],'BL':M[h//2:,:w//2],'BR':M[h//2:,w//2:]}
# Verify demo match again quickly then build test output
def f(I):
    I=np.array(I); Q=quads(I); h,w=Q['TL'].shape
    O=[]
    for i in range(h):
        row=[]
        for j in range(w):
            vals=[int(Q[q][i,j]) for q in ['TL','TR','BL','BR']]
            c=collections.Counter(vals)
            odds=[v for v,kk in c.items() if kk%2==1]
            assert len(odds)==1, (i,j,vals,c)
            row.append(odds[0])
        O.append(row)
    return O
ok=all(np.array_equal(np.array(f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])),np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])) for n in range(1,8))
print('all demos ok:',ok)
out=f(G['Test input'])
open('test_ans.json','w').write(json.dumps(out))
print(json.dumps(out))
